Shenmue I/II - @COMMIT@
-------------------------------------------

This release reimplements the original Shenmue I and Shenmue II games for PC.


To install, copy Shenmue_e.exe into your Shenmue I & II installation directory, inside the sm1 subdirectory, alongside Shenmue.exe.
Copy Shenmue2_e.exe into your Shenmue I & II installation directory, inside the sm2 subdirectory, alongside Shenmue2.exe.

Launch Shenmue_e.exe for Shenmue I, or Shenmue2_e.exe for Shenmue II.
